releaseNotes: Keeps the hardware-confirmed Notes 0.12.18 writing, resize, geometry persistence and overflow-only growth unchanged
Fixes insertion color being reset to black as soon as typing resumes
The selected text color is now kept independently for the active text block and re-applied to newly inserted characters after every native BOOX input event
Existing characters keep their original colors while new characters use the currently selected color
Selecting a text range and choosing a color continues to affect only that selection
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
